# VJ Suave, New Media Art Studio

VJ Suave is a Brazil-based new media art studio led by Ceci Soloaga (Argentina) and Ygor Marotta (Brazil). Since 2009, they have created immersive installations, audiovisual performances, and collaborations that blend animation, projection mapping, and music.

## Birds of Northeast Brazil

“Birds of Northeast Brazil” is an immersive installation by VJ Suave. With 360° projections on four walls and the floor, the artists lead the audience on a unique journey through the nuances of Ceará’s nature. This installation showcases the diversity of 29 birds in its different environments, all represented in 2D and 3D animations, transforming into audiovisual narratives that celebrate the unique beauty of these birds in their habitats.

The work was developed at the invitation of Director Silas de Paula to become part of the permanent collection of the Museum of Image and Sound of Ceará.

## Roda de Força

Roda de Força is a projection mapping work, a tribute to Mestre Moa do Katendê.

## Tupinambá

Tupinambá is a projection-mapping work created in collaboration with Glicéria Tupinambá. The piece, created in 2020, was featured at the Amazonia Mapping Festival in Belém do Pará, participating in both the 2023 and 2024 editions.

At the heart of their work is the Suaveciclo: the audiovisual performance on wheels. Riding a custom tricycle equipped with a projector and sound system, the artists bring character animations to walls, trees, and streets, transforming the urban landscape into a playground of light and storytelling. Each projection is improvised, shaped by the rhythm of the ride and the reactions of the people around.

# Julien Levy
URL: https://www.julienlevy.studio/

Julien Levy

# Light. Form. Feeling.

 Immersive experience design. Paris & beyond. 

## Projects & Collections

2026

Boudoir

Immersive Installation · AI · 4D Gaussian Splatting

2007, 2019

Immersive Productions

VR · 360° · XR · 400+ Projects

Artistic Statement

Millions are embracing slow living. Lofi music, ambient video, cozy aesthetics, a generation is collectively turning away from overstimulation and toward stillness, warmth, and beauty. The phenomenon is real and profound. Now imagine that same feeling inhabiting your space, responding to your presence, alive around you.

Boudoir makes it physical.

Born from a lifetime loving France, between Provence, Paris and Brittany, Boudoir is a triptych of living windows, each one a distillation of a place I have known and loved deeply. A Provençal mas at dusk, its lap pool glowing blue against ancient stone. A Paris rooftop at golden hour, the majestic Eiffel Tower on new-year's eve. A Breton harbor on a moonlit night, sun and rain on the same day.

Each scene breathes between day and night. A gesture of the hand, slow, natural, unhurried, shifts the light, changes the mood, moves the world in response to yours. The body becomes part of the work. Presence is the medium.

This is the heart of Boudoir, that small, profound moment when you raise your hand and the world listens. Anxiety releases. Time slows. And somewhere in the quiet glow of stone, water and familiar light, you remember... The world is full of your happy places, waiting.

Film

Three Scenes

Provence

A Provençal mas at dusk, lap pool glowing blue against ancient stone

Paris

A rooftop at golden hour, the Eiffel Tower on New Year's Eve

Brittany

A harbor on a moonlit night, sun and rain on the same day

Technical Details

Built on 4D Gaussian Splatting, an emerging frontier adopted by leading research labs worldwide, rendering scenes as millions of light-responsive particles in real time, with time as a fourth dimension. A custom streaming pipeline feeds a real-time renderer for live playback on an 85" 4K display. A depth-sensing camera reads body gestures: swipe to shift day to night, raise a hand to change scene.

Display 85" 4K UHD LED

Interaction Full-body gesture tracking

Rendering 4D Gaussian Splatting, real-time

Pipeline AI image generation, depth reconstruction, Unity

Gestures Swipe , day/night · Raise hand , switch scene

Format Single scene, looping ambient playback

2007 , 2019

## Immersive Productions

From 2007 to 2019, Julien led Digital Immersion, one of France's first dedicated VR and 360° production studios, delivering over 400 immersive experiences for brands, broadcasters, and cultural institutions across Europe. The work spanned interactive mobile applications, cinematic VR films, and live event broadcasting, earning a Cannes Lion d'Or for Renault and a Tribeca Film Festival nomination for Sergeant James.
